main_reference: Current user Plane233 C01: colored original open boundary runs as length/placement correspondences. All current nine PNGs and plugins were read. This proposal preserves actual colored material under explicit cut/assembly witnesses rather than declaring colors ignorable.
historical_difference: Old Plane218 was prescreen only. Own p01 C bounding-box comparison and p02 U orientation comparison both ended B,C and are not retried. This new native-boundary design compares global retained-perimeter accounting across every choice, with no external bracket, no fixed source cut and no selected-option salience. It introduces an independently certified exact material-color reading and a specific false conservation inference unique to D.
limitation: Detachment is a deliberate adaptation needed by the physical-piece semantics. It is subject to parent independent review.
